baselinePretest.purpose: Stratify general rule-application competence without exposing Noru rules.

items.prompt: Temporary rule: glim changes east to west and changes nothing else. Apply glim to east/tall.
Temporary rule: when a token is soft, tap makes it hard and adds one; when hard, tap makes it soft and adds zero. Apply tap twice to soft/2.
Temporary rule: a pair passes if labels differ, except two marked tokens never pass. Do marked/A and marked/B pass?
Apply echo, flip, echo to ava/plain/2.
Are bor/plain/1 and bor/ring/3 compatible? Explain.
items.answer: Yes; same band and counts total 4; the two-ring exception does not apply.

items.prompt: Are ava/ring/2 and bor/ring/2 compatible? Explain.
items.answer: No; different bands and same mark would qualify, but two ring cards are never compatible.

items.prompt: Apply flip, echo, echo to bor/plain/3.
Are ava/plain/3 and bor/plain/1 compatible? Explain.
items.answer: Yes; bands differ and marks match; the two-ring exception does not apply.

items.prompt: Are bor/ring/1 and bor/ring/3 compatible? Explain.
items.answer: No; same-band counts total 4, but two ring cards are never compatible.

items.prompt: A card became bor/plain/2 after echo. List every possible immediately previous card and justify each.
A learner says echo, echo always adds two to count. Give the smallest counterexample and explain the correct branches.
answerCriteria: first and second echo branches are distinguished
shows that ring echo does not advance count

items.prompt: Construct two cards that meet one base compatibility condition but are rejected by the exception. Explain both steps.
answerCriteria: a base same-band-sum-4 or different-band-same-mark condition is met

misconceptions.description: flip changes mark or count in addition to band
plain echo changes mark but does not advance count
count 3 does not wrap to 1 under plain echo
ring echo advances count as if the card were plain
operations are applied right to left or independently from the original state
compatibility requires all base conditions rather than either applicable condition
the two-ring exception is ignored or treated as a positive condition
echo is assumed to have one unconditional branch

parallelFormBoundary.knownDifference: Immediate form tests plain-wrap directly while delayed form tests plain-advance directly; both also exercise wrap or advance inside composition. This difference must be examined during calibration rather than called equivalent by assertion.
